metadata.title: SEP-PRISM Data:   A multi-source dataset for solar energetic particle forecasting
metadata.description:
A curated, multi-source dataset for 24-hour-ahead forecasting of operational solar energetic particle (SEP) events, defined as GOES integral primary >10 MeV proton flux ≥ 10 pfu (NOAA operational threshold).

The database integrates five solar-driver families—active-region magnetograms (SMHARP), flares, CME catalogues (CDAWDONKI), GOES soft X-ray flux (XRS-B), and GOES >10 MeV proton flux—with ground-truth SEP labels from the CLEAR Benchmark / FetchSEP catalogue. All records are harmonised into fixed rolling 24-hour windows suitable for supervised machine learning, benchmark comparison, and feature analysis.

Coverage: 3 February 1986 – 10 September 2025 (UTC) for analysed rolling-window tables
Companion publication: Yu et al., Scientific Reports Data Descriptor — [arXiv:2607.16160]

Highlights

Item Detail
Primary ML table Analyzed Data/rolling_combinded_seq_24hours.csv — 14,464 rows × 274 columns (~33 MB)
Operational SEP positives 650 / 14,464 rows (4.5%) with Future_OSEP_label = 1
General SEP positives 2,122 / 14,464 rows (14.7%) with Future_GSEP_label = 1
Predictor families SMHARP (full + flare-matched subset), flares, CDAWDONKI CME, CDAW CME, proton flux, XRS-B
Extended archives SMHARP (SHARP extended to 1996 via SMARP); CDAWDONKI (DONKI-like CME features extended via CDAW)
Reproducibility Full Python acquisition + R preprocessing/aggregation pipeline included

 

Repository structure

SEP-Prediction-Database/
├── Raw Data/                    # Upstream downloads and SEP event catalogue
│   ├── GOES_integral_PRIMARY.*_sep_events.csv
│   ├── flare_raw.csv, sharp_raw.csv, smarp_raw.csv
│   ├── cdaw_cme_raw.csv, donki_cme_raw.csv, goes_10mev_flux_raw.csv
│   ├── GOES-ProtonFlux/         # Per-satellite integral flux + status tables
│   └── GOES-XRS/                # Per-satellite soft X-ray flux (GOES-06–18)
├── Processed Data/              # Fused, gap-filled feature tables
│   ├── SMHARP.csv               # ~5.31M rows, ~1.9 GB
│   ├── Flare.csv, CDAWDONKI_CME.csv, CDAW_CME.csv
│   ├── GOESHAPI_ProtonFlux.csv, Merged_XRays.csv
│   └── All_features.RData       # Bundled workspace for aggregation
├── Analyzed Data/               # Model-ready rolling-window tables
│   ├── rolling_combinded_seq_24hours.csv   # Primary benchmark table (~33 MB)
│   └── rolling_combinded_seq_1hours.csv    # 1-hour step, overlapping (~803 MB)
└── Code/
    ├── fetch_solar_data.ipynb   # Python: download raw data from external archives
    ├── All_features_RData.R     # Build R workspace from processed CSVs
    ├── Data_Aggregation.R       # Build rolling-window ML tables
    ├── Dataset_Preprocessing/   # Fusion and feature-extraction scripts
    └── Plot/                    # Figure-generation scripts
        ├── dataspan.R
        ├── sharp_smarp_plot.R
        └── Figures/
